verdict.rationale: RevenueCat's docs say it 'can send you notifications any time an event happens in your app', and its GitHub README advertises real-time events through webhooks, which covers the core of the story. The evidence is high-level only and does not enumerate the specific lifecycle events or describe delivery guarantees. Missing for 10: documented event types (renewal, upgrade/product change, billing issue, cancellation), reliability details (retries, signing/authorization, idempotency), independent or hands-on corroboration.
